A fresh ledger with only a `set` row (`period=1w, horizon=6w` plus the pre-round-7 defaults spelled out) and a `team` row, run at 08:00 on the anchor Monday, one hour before the first shift. DESIGN 5.2 raises the snapshot instant to the anchor (09:00) and to the team row, so `S` is 2026-06-01T09:00; the team row at the same instant sorts after the snapshot per 3.6, so the roster at `S` is empty and no `snapshot` row is written (3.4): the next run writes it once `S` has moved past the team row. Six weekly slots up to the horizon boundary 2026-07-13 are filled round robin alice, bob, carol, dave, alice, bob because every score is zero and the `order` tiebreak walks the roster from the top, then from the member after the previous assignee. The settings block of `expected/status.txt` is dated at `now`, before the first `set` row, so it shows the built-in defaults. Those defaults include `autopin=a:2sl`, resolved on the grid of the `set` row extended backwards to `now` (DESIGN 3.5), so the two shifts starting within two weeks of `now` carry the `a` marker.
